metadata.title: International higher-education presence in Vietnam - supplement 4
metadata.scope: New names found after previous foreign/international supplements. These are not separate Vietnamese university legal entities unless explicitly stated; most are TNE/joint/delivery programmes.

institutions.name: Kyungpook National University Vietnam Program
institutions.notes: FPT announced the KNU Vietnam program on 2026-03-05. Technology and Business curricula are transferred from KNU and bachelor degrees are awarded directly by KNU.

institutions.name: Bournemouth University at British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: Bournemouth University degrees have been delivered at BUV from September 2025 under a TNE partnership.

institutions.name: University of Staffordshire at British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: One of BUV's UK awarding university partners.

institutions.name: University of Stirling at British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: Listed among BUV's UK awarding university partners.

institutions.name: Arts University Bournemouth at British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: BUV delivers programmes accredited/awarded in partnership with Arts University Bournemouth.

institutions.name: Manchester Metropolitan University at British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: BUV's sixth UK TNE partner; current dual-degree programmes are advertised in 2026.

institutions.name: University of Lincoln joint programme at UEH
institutions.host_in_vietnam: University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City
institutions.notes: UEH IBR operates the LINCOLn Bachelor 1+2 programme; the degree is awarded by the University of Lincoln.

institutions.name: University of St. Francis programme at VNU-UEB
institutions.host_in_vietnam: VNU University of Economics and Business
institutions.notes: UEB-SITE identifies an active BBA-USF programme with degree awarded by the University of St. Francis.

institutions.name: Ming Chuan University programme at Foreign Trade University
institutions.notes: FTU offers an International Business & Trade programme with a bachelor's degree issued by Ming Chuan University.

institutions.name: Curtin University programme at Foreign Trade University
institutions.host_in_vietnam: Foreign Trade University - Ho Chi Minh City Campus
institutions.notes: FTU and Curtin University cooperate on the Bachelor of Commerce in Logistics and Supply Chain Management; FTU still refers to Curtin as a partner in 2026.

institutions.name: HELP University dual-degree programme at VNU International School
institutions.notes: VNU documented a dual-degree Bachelor in Marketing programme with HELP University. Current 2026 admissions status should be rechecked before marking active.
